reviews.title: Great Price. good looking and quiet
reviews.comment: Great fans at a great price. I bought these to replace my Thermalright 120mm  front fans in my H7 Flow (2024). You can't fail with these fans.
reviews.author: SCOTT GORDON

reviews.title: They Work as advertised
reviews.comment: They're fans.  They spin, they're quiet, and they light up.
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.title: Solid budget friendly option
reviews.comment: Fans are very colorful and move a large volume of air. Also quiet mode is very much quiet. Definitely preferred saving money with these fans as the are good value for money. Had no issues installing the fans and they did not feel cheap or flimsy. These 140mm fans are awesome my only problem is that I did not see them with a reverse fan blade option.
reviews.author: Zalgo Cometh

reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: Beautiful leds.. fans push a bunch of air.. very impressed for the price point..
